title: Edition 03
description:
Design Day is a monthly meetup for designers.

The agenda includes:

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This will be a group activity, the participants will be split into groups of 4-5 people.

We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.
We'll need to share your name and email with the security and we'll ask you to share the same with us on Friday.

This event is strictly for designers.

Cheers,

Team Design Day
